items.claim: Uros Medic possesses faster hand speed than Daniel Rodriguez.
Uros Medic has been more active in his career recently than Daniel Rodriguez.
Daniel Rodriguez has spent a long time away from MMA competition, which negatively impacts his readiness.
items.quote: D-Rod's been in prison long time away. And that's not really conducive to knowing how to fight in professional MMA fighters.

items.claim: Uros Medic gets dropped frequently during fights and cannot comfortably walk through fire.
items.quote: He ends up getting dropped at some point. He gets dropped pretty frequently. He's not somebody who is going to be able to walk through the fire

items.claim: Uros Medic relies heavily on early finishes rather than prolonged battles.
items.quote: He either beats you early or you beat him.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez throws a very smooth and constant left hook that could catch Medic.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez throws a really smooth left hand... D-Rod throws that left hook constantly.

items.claim: Uros Medic has a history of being dropped in fights by Gilbert Urbina, Matt Semelsberger, and Punahele Soriano.
items.quote: This was a guy who got dropped by Gilbert Erbina. This guy got dropped by Matt Semllesburgger. This guy got dropped by Puna Heliano.
